intents.name: greeting
intents.response: Hello! I am your Internship Assistant. I can help you with internship timings, duration, tasks, applications, attendance, certificates, and technical questions.

intents.name: internship_timings
patterns: What time does the internship start?
What time does the internship end?
What are the working hours for the internship?
intents.response: The internship working hours are Monday to Friday, from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

intents.name: internship_duration
patterns: How many days is the internship?
How many months is the internship?
How long do I need to complete the internship?
intents.response: The internship duration depends on the assigned program and its specific requirements. Please refer to your internship assignment for the exact duration.

intents.name: tasks
patterns: Where can I find my tasks?
What work do I need to complete?
What projects do I need to complete?
What should I do for the internship?
intents.response: Your assigned tasks are listed in the internship instructions or project assignment provided to you. Please refer to those materials for the complete task details.

intents.name: eligibility
patterns: Who can apply for the internship?
Am I eligible for the internship?
intents.response: Eligibility depends on the requirements of the specific internship program. Please check the official internship requirements for the applicable eligibility criteria.

intents.name: application
patterns: How do I apply for the internship?
How can I register for the internship?
intents.response: Please follow the official internship application or registration process provided by the internship program.

intents.name: documents
intents.response: Required documents depend on the internship program. Please refer to the official internship instructions for the current document requirements.

intents.name: attendance
patterns: Do I need to maintain attendance?
Where can I check my attendance?
intents.response: Attendance requirements depend on the internship program. Please follow the attendance instructions provided by your internship coordinator.

intents.name: leave
patterns: Can I take a day off?
How do I apply for leave?
intents.response: Leave availability and approval depend on the internship program. Please contact your internship coordinator before taking leave.

intents.name: certificate
patterns: How do I get my internship certificate?
When will I receive my certificate?
Do I receive a completion certificate?
intents.response: Certificate availability and eligibility depend on successful completion of the internship requirements. Please follow the official completion process.

intents.name: completion
patterns: How do I complete the internship?
How can I finish my internship?
What do I need to submit for completion?
intents.response: Complete all assigned tasks and follow the submission and completion requirements provided by your internship program.

intents.name: mentor
patterns: How can I contact my mentor?
Who should I contact for guidance?
I need help from my mentor
intents.response: Please use the mentor or coordinator details provided with your internship assignment to contact the appropriate person for guidance.

intents.name: technical_support
patterns: How can I get technical support?
I have a problem with the project
intents.response: Please describe your technical issue in detail, and I will help you identify the appropriate solution.

intents.name: project_submission
patterns: How do I submit my project?
Where should I submit my project?
How can I submit my task?
Where do I upload my project?
How do I submit completed work?
intents.response: Please follow the project submission instructions provided with your internship assignment and submit your completed work through the specified platform.

intents.name: deadline
patterns: When do I need to submit?
When should I complete the project?
intents.response: Please refer to your internship assignment or official instructions for the exact submission deadline.

intents.name: goodbye
intents.response: Goodbye! Best of luck with your internship and your projects.

intents.name: thanks
intents.response: You're welcome! I'm happy to help. Feel free to ask another internship-related question.
